context: A Tuesday evening phone call. Kenji, between meetings, calls his mother. She picks up on the second ring.
purpose: adult son to aging mother — light maintenance call with a small genuine moment

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: Pleased recognition. The childhood diminutive still in use.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Mom — you good? Got a sec?
lines.style: Brisk but warm. Walking somewhere in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 元気よ。あなたは？仕事、大変じゃない？
lines.en: I'm well. And you? Work isn't too hard?
lines.style: The mother's first instinct: ask back. Voice gentle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: まあ、まあ。今日、長かった。
lines.style: Half-honest. Doesn't want to worry her, can't lie either.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: そう。無理しちゃ駄目よ。本当に。
lines.style: Slow, weighted. The 「本当に」 is the whole line.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うん。…明日は早く帰る予定。
lines.en: Yeah. …Planning to come home early tomorrow.
lines.style: A small offering of reassurance. Voice softer.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: The question she has been holding onto. Light, but real.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 今月中…たぶん。時間、作る。
lines.en: Within this month… probably. I'll make time.
lines.style: A promise to himself as much as her. Walks faster in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 無理しないで。…声、聞けたから、それでいい。
lines.en: Don't push yourself. …Just hearing your voice — that's enough.
lines.style: The line every adult child eventually hears. Slow, real.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Smaller. Caught by the line. A beat before he speaks.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: Closing line, the universal mom version. Affectionate.
